natural_body: SMB 40% discounts lifted acquisition and near-term revenue but cut retention 12%.

first.rationale: Current data shows activation and onboarding completion are both declining QoQ. Memory 31 and 86 are the most directly relevant: both show that simplifying/shortening onboarding drove durable improvements in activation and completion rates. These are the exact metrics now under pressure. Verifying these two records will confirm the magnitude and persistence of prior gains. Promotional pricing (memory_73) is explicitly contraindicated due to retention risk. Referral incentives work in established customers (memory_57) but don't address the immediate activation/onboarding friction. Activation_messaging alone (memory_91) helped but likely works best in concert with smoother onboarding. Enterprise_sales_assist is valuable (memory_44) but addresses a different segment and doesn't solve the SMB activation leak that competitors are exploiting. Simplify_onboarding directly targets both declining metrics, leverages proven prior impact, and carries lower downstream risk than promotional pricing. Standard_experiment scale is appropriate for validating whether prior gains still hold in the current competitive environment.
